summary: `manifest.yml` holds the artifact metadata: `aap_version` (X.Y), the source `platform` (for example `rpm`) and a `components` list with name and version for controller, hub and gateway.
questions: What goes in the migration manifest.yml?
How do I record component versions for migration?

answer_card.title: manifest.yml
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
---
aap_version: X.Y
platform: rpm
components:
  - name: controller
    version: x.y.z
  - name: hub
    version: x.y.z
  - name: gateway
    version: x.y.z
```
